nom: Patchology FlashPatch Restoring Night Eye Gels

segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin, including some prone to eczema around the eyes, report no irritation and moisturized, calmed skin after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s and 40s citing lost volume, fine lines, and wrinkles report visible smoothing and firming with regular use, though some see limited change over time.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the gels for fine lines, wrinkles, and volume loss around the eyes report a smoother, firmer, more youthful look with retinol and peptides cited as helpful; one reviewer in her mid-30s reports slower but ongoing improvement.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated under-eyes consistently report immediate hydration, softness, and a plumped feel lasting into the next day.

aspects.libelle: Patches slide or fall off face
High price relative to amount of product
No irritation on sensitive or eczema-prone skin

extraits.texte: Probably the worst cosmetic purchase I've ever made. Tge patches do not stay on unless I'm laying flat on my back even then they slide down. I saw no difference after using. Thankfully I bought them when they were 50%.

I never write reviews, but I had to for these. I wore these last night for eight hours woke up this morning with no eye bags and looking refreshed. Usually when I wake up, my skin is saggy or puffy or both…. I have sensitive skin and these did not irritate my skin at all. I actually rubbed all the extra theorem all over my face and neck. I really wish it had Cleaner ingredients but it works so well I will definitely repurchase. Im 42 and have always had tired eyes..

As im hitting my mid 30s im losing volume ybser my eyes. I got these to see if theyd help and so far they have been helping, the only issue i have with these is fhat they are incredibly slippery and slide right off your face. I have had to remove some of the serum off the patch to get it so it's not as slippery

I couldnt believe how well this smoothed out and brightened up my undereyes after the first use! I have very sensitive skin and am prone to eczema outbreaks around my eyes but these didnt irritate my skin and left the area moisturized! I have repurchased several times!

The eye patches stay put while I walk around my home doing chores and folding laundry. im not sure why some people say they don't stay on, perhaps they aren't applying them correctly. The gel patches absorb serum, making them slightly slippery, but they still stay in place. I plan to bring these with me whenever I travel to help soothe my tired eyes. While I haven't noticed a significant improvement yet, I do feel that my under-eye area looks more refreshed. I love the soothing sensation and have noticed they help reduce puffiness and make my dark circles less pronounced. I enjoy using these at night because they contain retinol and peptides, along with arnica extract to target fine lines, dark circles, and puffiness. I love waking up looking more well-rested the next day!

I am skeptic of products that read "restoring" This brand & product redeemed the beauty industry for me Left on for 45 mins in total before bed; overall past 3 weeks undereye less bag, dryness, conceler cracks, and darkness. Granted I have a night routine as well- paired together perfection< 3

extraits.titre: Not enough serum, no customer service
extraits.texte: I love these patches but in the last purchase, there were a weeks worth of patches left but not enough serum. Total waste of money. I tried calling the number on the package but it just played music when answered. I also tried emailing but no response. This is so upsetting considering how much this product costs.
